# FDG8067

> DO override `Equals` on value types.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.9.1.1 Equals on Value Types.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1815
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test suggestion
- Status: draft

CA1815 reports an externally visible struct that does not override Equals; it also reports a struct without the equality operators, which FDG8105 asks for. In a probe with SDK 10.0.402 it did not report a struct without fields, an enumerator struct or an internal struct, so coverage is partial; a struct with only const fields is reported (noise samples). The SDK code fix adds Equals and GetHashCode overrides that throw NotImplementedException (probe), so autofix is no. A suggestion: in the noise samples 1 of 2 reports was a struct with only const fields, which has no field for the default Equals to compare.

## From the book

The default implementation uses reflection to access and compare all the fields. In consequence, it is often unacceptably inefficient.
